name: Exasol
tagline: In-memory MPP columnar analytics database from Germany, tuned for fast BI with little tuning.
description: Exasol is a German in-memory, columnar MPP database that has long topped TPC-H performance tables. It keeps hot data in RAM, creates and maintains indexes automatically, and parallelizes queries across nodes, so BI tools get fast answers without much tuning. It runs on-premises, in your cloud or as Exasol SaaS, with UDFs in Python, R, Java and Lua and a free Personal edition. Recent releases position it as a 'sovereign' analytics database for AI agents, with an MCP server and Parquet/lakehouse loading. It is a good BI accelerator; the ecosystem is smaller than the US hyperscalers'.

pricing.notes: Free Personal/Community edition; commercial licences by memory or cores; SaaS billed by usage.

scale.notes: Shared-nothing MPP cluster; performance best when the hot working set fits in cluster RAM.

strengths: Very fast BI queries from in-memory columnar MPP execution
Self-tuning: indexes and statistics are created automatically
UDFs in Python, R, Java and Lua run inside the database
Deploys on-prem, in any major cloud or as SaaS; EU-based vendor
Free Personal edition for evaluation and small projects
weaknesses: RAM-heavy sizing raises hardware cost for large datasets
Smaller ecosystem and community than mainstream warehouses
Fewer native lakehouse and streaming features
useCases: BI acceleration layer for Tableau or Power BI
